blog_title: Royal Blue vs Navy T-Shirt Colour Difference — ₹45K Bulk Order Cancelled Over 1 Shade
caption:
🚨 DTF prints peeling in monsoon? It's not your heat press — it's humidity.

When moisture hits 70%+, it settles on PET film and weakens the adhesive bond. Standard 160°C won't cut it in rainy season. Pre-heat the film 3-4 seconds first, then bump temperature to 170°C. These three numbers matter: 70% humidity, 170°C, pre-heat.

Save this if you're printing through monsoon 👇
